main.content: {{Top}} {{Otheruses|Ryloth}} {{Conjecture}} {{TerrestrialRegion |image= |name=Ryloth's northern continent |type= |location=[[Ryloth]]''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' |terrain=Barren |fauna= |flora= |otherlife= |interest=A village |cities= |created= |destroyed= |affiliation= }} The [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] possessed a '''northern continent''' that was barren. On the continent there existed a village which [[Lyn Me]], a [[Twi'lek]] dancer, grew up there. At one point in [[time]], [[Enslaver|slavers]] invaded the continent and kidnapped Me, and many other Twi'leks, from the village. The village elders pooled enough [[Currency|money]] to pay the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] to save the kidnapped Twi'leks and return them to the village. ==Behind the scenes== The [[Ryloth's northern continent/Legends|continent]] originated in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity when it was first mentioned in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article by [[Rich Handley]] published in the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}} which was released on [[April 15]], [[2003]].{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate Jedi's 20th in ''Insider'' #67}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|39|Databank A-Z}} {{1stm}} *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia, New Edition]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Continente norte de Ryloth }} [[Category:Continents]] [[Category:Ryloth locations]]
